title: Lumino Industries IPO Details
intro:
Lumino Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹700.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 6.10 crore shares aggregating to ₹500.00 crores and offer for sale of 2.44 crore shares aggregating to ₹200.00 crores.

Lumino Industries IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 27, 2026 and will close on Aug 31, 2026. The allotment for the Lumino Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 1, 2026. Lumino Industries IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 3, 2026.

Lumino Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹78 to ₹82 per share. The lot size for an application is 182 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,924 (182 shares) (based on upper price).

Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Lumino Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2005, Lumino Industries Ltd. is an integrated engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company in India, with a focus on manufacturing and supplying conductors, power cables, electrical wires and specialised products for the power transmission and distribution industry.
The Company also manufactures high-temperature low-sag (HTLS) conductors used in transmission and distribution lines.

The Company operates through two key segments: Manufacturing and EPC. Its manufacturing business covers aluminium conductors, power cables and electrical wires, while its EPC business includes power transmission and distribution, EHV substations, HTLS re-conductoring, railway electrification, solar power projects and water management projects.

Lumino Industries supplies its products to major EPC players in India and also serves international customers, including government-owned electricity companies, public enterprises and electricity boards across countries such as the USA, Mali, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Nepal, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ghana, Rwanda and Ethiopia.
As of March 31, 2026, the Company had 890 permanent employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Lumino Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Lumino Industries IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Lumino Industries IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Lumino Industries IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Lumino Industries IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Lumino Industries IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Lumino Industries IPO opens on Thu, Aug 27, 2026 and closes on Mon, Aug 31, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Lumino Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: Lumino Industries IPO lot size is 182 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,924 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Lumino Industries IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Lumino Industries IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Lumino Industries IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Lumino Industries IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 1, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 2, 2026 . Check the Lumino Industries IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Lumino Industries IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Lumino Industries IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Sep 3, 2026 .
